scope: One disposable Kind Kubernetes v1.36.1 cluster with an ephemeral Secretbox EncryptionConfiguration for core Secret API objects, one small synthetic checkpoint, synthetic optimizer metadata, and one unencrypted ConfigMap comparator. Exact etcd records are checked inside the case cluster. Namespaced Roles grant named GET/UPDATE only for the mock trainer's restore Secret, and named GET for checkpoint inputs and the digest manifest; a separate observer can GET only the restore Secret. An ordinary mock Pod demonstrates denied Secret GET/PATCH. A second untrusted request attempts a metadata-only patch to the exact checkpoint input Secret; an independent API readback checks its UID, resourceVersion, and data hashes remain unchanged. This does not test filesystem/PV or cloud object-store encryption, KMS/key custody or rotation, production identities, human authorization, distributed storage, or actual ML training.

checks.claim: The synthetic ConfigMap comparator is stored in cleartext
The checkpoint Secret is ciphertext in etcd and hides its fixture bytes
A changed checkpoint fails its detached digest check before restore
An unbound workload identity is denied checkpoint read and restore write
An unbound workload cannot patch the named checkpoint input Secret and its identity and contents remain unchanged
The authorized mock trainer restores validated bytes for an independent exact-content read
Trainer RBAC grants only named API operations in the owned namespace
Checkpoint and optimizer match trusted input digests and are AEAD-encrypted before their PVC write
A separate keyless read-only Pod observes nonempty envelopes without fixture plaintext
Authorized restore authenticates both artifacts and checks trusted digests before memory-only output
A controlled changed copy is distinct while the valid PVC envelope remains unchanged
Altered ciphertext fails AEAD before any plaintext restore output is created
